sources_used: Arcade Maps scrapers/ziv.py + README (GHA/ITG/StepMania/Beat Saber map to other; maimai -> maimai_dx)

findings.name: Past Times Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Games table lists Guitar Hero Arcade (International), Free Play, Perfect. Venue page updated 2026-01-31. Massive retro arcade and pinball museum; official site confirms 400+ pinball and 200+ classic arcade games free-play.
findings.note: Only tracked music cab is Guitar Hero Arcade (repo maps GHA to other). No Bemani/SEGA rhythm cabs on ZIv or site.

findings.name: Penn Social
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists Beat Saber Arcade only (updated 2023-06-01). Comment ~1 month ago: 'Beat Saber Arcade might not be here anymore either, or at least not in the bar area.' Older comment: 'Used to have DDR, no longer does.'
findings.note: Venue still open as DC sports bar/event space. Music cab status currently unconfirmed; not certain enough for has_games.

findings.name: Player 1UP (Rock Hill)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv cab notes include Guitar Hero Arcade among pinball and classic arcade lineup. Venue site player1up.com and Facebook still active for Rock Hill (Murrells Inlet branch closed separately March 2025).
findings.note: Rock Hill location still operating. Only music-adjacent cab in ZIv is Guitar Hero Arcade -> other. No recent independent lineup reconfirm.

findings.name: Playland Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade among seaside redemption/video cabs (Hampton NH boardwalk Playland).
findings.note: Seasonal boardwalk arcade. Only tracked music title is GHA -> other. No modern Bemani/SEGA rhythm titles found.

findings.name: Playtime Arcade Bar
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade plus family redemption/racing cabs. Website playtimepartycenter.com.
findings.note: Wentzville MO. GHA only for music slug mapping -> other.

findings.name: Powered by Pac Main Entertainment - Oxford
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Guitar Hero Arcade among redemption/skill cabs (Basketball, Claw, Halo Fireteam Raven, etc.). Site pacmanplay.com.
findings.note: Oxford AL family entertainment. Only music cab GHA -> other.

findings.name: Press Start Arcade & Bar
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade with retro fighters/classics (Daytona Championship USA, Street Fighter II CE, etc.). Site renopressstart.com.
findings.note: Reno NV barcade. GHA only music-mapped cab -> other.

findings.name: Prince Arcades
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Guitar Hero Arcade; 電車でGO!3通勤編. Official site princearcades.com: admission-based arcade Bolingbrook IL, $20 unlimited free play, still advertising as open.
findings.note: Densha de Go is not a valid rhythm slug here. Only GHA maps to other. No maimai/DDR/BEMANI confirmation on site.

findings.name: Putters
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv lists StepMania Converted Cabinet only; page last updated 2016-04-01. Comment thread years later asks for updates. PNW Bemani forum historically noted StepMania on pads. Venue still open (entertainmenteugene.com Putters).
findings.note: Venue open with arcade area, but StepMania cab presence not reconfirmed in ~10 years. StepMania converted != stepmaniax commercial product. Honest unknown rather than stale has_games.

findings.name: Quaker Steak & Lube
findings.evidence_quote: Columbus Polaris restaurant still listed open at 8500 Lyra Dr. ZIv only ever listed Guitar Hero Arcade for this sid; no recent cab reconfirm on ZIv or restaurant pages.
findings.note: Restaurant open; GHA status unknown (restaurant arcades churn). Not enough for has_games.

findings.name: Queen & Rook Game Cafe
findings.evidence_quote: StepMania Converted Cabinet (International): StepMania running on a converted DDR Extreme cabinet with an Extreme theme. Free Play, Moderate. ZIv updated 2026-01-28. Photo: SM on a DDR Extreme cab.
findings.note: PhillyVoice 2024 marketing said 'Dance Dance Revolution' generically; pinballmap mentions DDR Extreme hardware. Software is StepMania, not live DDR e-amusement. Maps to other (not ddr, not stepmaniax).

findings.name: Regal Cinema Pinnacle Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv last updated 2010-12-08. Info: 'This location no longer has a DDR machine.' Games table still shows Guitar Hero Arcade from that era only.
findings.note: 15+ year stale cinema arcade listing. No modern confirmation of GHA or any rhythm cab.

findings.name: Regal Cinemas Village Park 17
findings.evidence_quote: Shard/ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade for Carmel IN theater arcade. No recent public lineup or ZIv refresh found.
findings.note: Cinema lobby arcade; GHA often removed. Nothing findable recent enough to assert has_games.

findings.name: Revolution Laser Tag
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America), left of front desk; Simply Love type theme; .25 for 1 song, Moderate. Updated 2024-04-30. Comment: 'its real theres a dedicab here'. Photo: real dedicab.
findings.note: ITG2 dedicab maps to other per repo (USA_EXTRA series 8). Venue site revolutionlasertag.com still active Clinton Twp MI.

findings.name: Riverside Arcades
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Guitar Hero Arcade; Quick Shot; Space Invaders Frenzy; Tekken 5 Version 5.1. Riverside Resort Laughlin NV entertainment page historically listed arcade.
findings.note: Casino resort arcade. Only music-mapped title GHA -> other. No recent reconfirm.

findings.name: Rochester Galaxy 14 Cinema
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv only In the Groove 2; last updated 2013-06-23 (13 years ago). No visitors, no pictures, no comments. Wehrenberg theater URL is legacy.
findings.note: ITG may have been removed long ago. Stale cinema listing; cannot claim has_games.

findings.name: Rockin' Raceway
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes include Guitar Hero Arcade among large Pigeon Forge redemption lineup. faceamusement.com/experiences/rockin-raceway/ still markets the venue.
findings.note: Family fun center still operating. GHA -> other only for music slug set.

findings.name: Roxy's Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade listed Perfect; ZIv updated 2025-10-07 by ArcadeSock. Picture gallery includes photo titled Guitar Hero, House of the Dead 2 (thumbnail 69909).
findings.note: Cambridge MA barcade (ex-A4cade). GHA only music title -> other. No DDR/maimai/etc. on 2025 list.

findings.name: Roy F. Collier Community Center
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade. Community center recreation; no recent public evidence the GHA cab remains.
findings.note: Inez KY community center. Single old GHA listing insufficient for has_games.

findings.name: Royal Magic Castle
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game table: maimai (Japan), 6 coins, Perfect. Comment: 'Do not change comment or game.' Condition labeled Japan. Updated 2025-04-09. Flushing NY indoor playground/arcade; site royalmagiccastle.com lists Arcade Zone.
findings.note: ZIv titles classic Japan maimai (not DX). Repo maps maimai classic titles into maimai_dx chip (merge.py). Not on ALL.Net intl locator found. No count beyond presence.

findings.name: Royal Scot Golf & Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade among bowling-alley arcade mix (Daytona USA 2, Crazy Taxi, Jurassic Park Arcade, etc.). Site royalscot.net.
findings.note: Lansing MI golf/bowling complex. GHA -> other.

findings.name: Rubik's Arcade Bar East
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes include Guitar Hero Arcade with large barcade mix (Mario Kart GP DX, Time Crisis 5, pinball, classics). Instagram @rubiks_east.
findings.note: El Paso TX. GHA only for music slug mapping -> other.

findings.name: Scandia Family Fun Center (Sacramento)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade among family fun center arcade (Time Crisis 3, House of the Dead 2, racing, etc.). Site scandiafun.com/sacramento/.
findings.note: Sacramento Scandia still markets location. GHA -> other only.

findings.name: Sea World (San Diego)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade and Monopoly Roll & Go for SeaWorld San Diego park arcade. Park still open; no recent confirmation GHA remains on floor.
findings.note: Theme-park arcade floor stock changes frequently. Stale GHA-only note not enough.

findings.name: Select Start Arcade & Bar
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv page for 2812 Elm Street Dallas still lists Guitar Hero Arcade etc. but last updated 2021-01-05. Yelp and local listings treat Select Start Arcade & Bar Deep Ellum as permanently closed; no active website.
findings.note: Deep Ellum Dallas barcade appears permanently closed. Do not attach another venue's games.

findings.name: Seminole Lanes
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade. Bowling center seminolelanes.com; no recent public cab list confirming GHA.
findings.note: Seminole FL bowling alley. GHA presence unconfirmed recently.

findings.name: Shake Shoppe Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America) upgraded Extreme cab; updated 2026-06-27. Condition Not Working. Comments June 2026: 'The ITG2 Upgrade cab was completely off when I checked in June 2026' / machine completely off. Cab still listed at location (back left corner).
findings.note: Seaside Heights boardwalk. ITG2 present but powered off OOO as of mid-2026. Maps to other. Venue open seasonally.

findings.name: Shore Fun Family Fun Center
findings.evidence_quote: Guitar Hero Arcade (Great, $1) and In the Groove 2 Andamiro dedicab (Great, $1 for 2 songs) both listed. Updated 2024-09-10. Site shorefunbethany.com; seasonal Bethany Beach DE.
findings.note: Both music cabs map to other (GHA + ITG2). No DDR/pump/stepmaniax on list.

findings.name: Sir Goony's Family Fun Center
findings.evidence_quote: Official site still operates Chattanooga location with arcade, go-karts, mini golf, batting cages. ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade for music.
findings.note: Venue open. GHA only music-mapped cab -> other; no recent lineup detail on site.

findings.name: Six Flags Great Escape Lodge & Indoor Waterpark
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes include Guitar Hero Arcade among lodge/waterpark arcade redemption mix. Lodge site sixflagsgreatescapelodge.com still active Queensbury NY.
findings.note: Resort arcade. GHA -> other only.

findings.name: Sluggers World Class Sports Bar and Grill
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade for Wrigleyville sports bar. Site sluggersbar.com is bar/sports focused; no current arcade cab list found.
findings.note: Chicago Clark St sports bar. GHA may or may not remain; not confirmed.

findings.name: Speedway Indoor Karting
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade with racing/shooter cabs. Site sikdaytona.com still operates Daytona Beach indoor karting + arcade.
findings.note: GHA -> other. No other valid rhythm slugs in notes.

findings.name: Sportime USA / LIFE The Place To Be
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 RoXoR dedicab still listed with detailed pad/LCD notes; 6 credits/1P. ZIv updated 2025-12-16. Historical comments: Extreme sold years ago; SN2 was for sale; ITG remained. Pricing block updated for 2025.
findings.note: Ardsley NY. ITG2 maps to other. DDR SuperNOVA2 / Extreme not on current ZIv games table. Hours change weekly per site.

findings.name: Sportland Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes include Guitar Hero Arcade among Ocean City MD boardwalk redemption arcade. Site sportlandarcade.com.
findings.note: Boardwalk arcade still operating. GHA -> other only in music set.

findings.name: Star Lanes Polaris
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes only Guitar Hero Arcade for Columbus Polaris bowling center. No recent public confirmation of the cab.
findings.note: Bowling alley arcade stock unverified for music cabs.

findings.name: Starcade (Century 25)
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes list Guitar Hero Arcade among Cinemark/Century theater lobby games (Union City CA). Theater lobby arcades churn; no recent reconfirm.
findings.note: Cinema Starcade. Treat as unknown without recent visit notes.

findings.name: Stop, Drop, and Play
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Guitar Hero Arcade; Mortal Kombat II; The Simpsons Arcade Game. Wayland MI; sparse web presence, no recent cab verification.
findings.note: Cannot confirm venue still has GHA or even still open as listed.

findings.name: SuperPlay
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv notes: Cruis'n Blast; Dirty Drivin'; Guitar Hero Arcade. Site superplayor.com Beaverton OR.
findings.note: GHA -> other. Small venue list; no Bemani/SEGA rhythm titles noted.

findings.name: TJ's haul house
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv: Private home - if you are interested in playing please send a text. StepMania Converted Cabinet: Stepmania 5.1 PC with DDR 5th Mix K-Cab pads. Free Play Perfect. Updated 2020-08-27 by owner tj28.
findings.note: Private residence Tampa FL, not a public arcade. StepMania home cab maps to other (not stepmaniax). Appointment/text only; status since 2020 unconfirmed.
